analogy.rationale: AGTR1 is a G protein-coupled receptor that is poorly expressed in most of these cell lines, so angiotensin receptor antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other renin-angiotensin system or GPCR-acting antagonists, with PPAR receptor antagonist included because PPARG is an annotated off-target.
